summary: When the air map mode's colours are made again: as an intercept or air superiority order of the player's starts or is destroyed.

addresses.name: CAirInterceptOrder::~CAirInterceptOrder
addresses.comment: The intercept's destructor body: writes its vftable, and first of all, where the in-game idler's map mode is 18 and the order's unit (+0x8) is the player's (+0x128 against the game state's player id): MapMode_Air_Colour on the graphics owner's +0x1DC4, then Map_RefreshColourTextures(0) - before the order is taken apart; then clears its string at +0xA8, runs 0x58E9B0 and CAirOrder::~CAirOrder. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x58EA00; bare `ret` at 0x58EB52. In no vftable: the scalar deleting destructor calls it.

addresses.name: MapMode_Air_Colour
addresses.comment: **The air map mode's colours.** Both colours of every province from 1 to 0x80808080; then for every unit of the map's country (CMap +0x2A88) whose order's slot 16 is 0x718 (air_intercept) or 0x6FA (air_superiority), every province of the order's list (+0x44) that the order's slot 38 passes (in range) is coloured: an intercept writes 0x8058FF58 to the first colour and to the second where it is still grey, an air superiority 0x80FF5858 to the second and to the first where it is still grey. So green, red, or striped under both. Called by MapMode_Air_Set, and where the in-game idler's map mode is 18 and the order's unit (+0x8) is the player's (+0x128 against the game state's player id) by CAirInterceptOrder::Start, CAirPatrol::Start and the two orders' destructors - never daily. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 1.
addresses.revises: Said MapMode_Air_Set was its only caller.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::DailyUpdate
addresses.comment: CInGameIdler virtual slot 53: repaints the map in modes 4/18/19, then always runs the autosave check. Takes nothing on the stack (bare `ret` on all three paths) and returns true - every path sets `al, 1` before the epilogue. The mode is the dword at +0xD34; mode 4 calls MapMode_Supply_Colour (0x266EE0); **mode 0x12, the air mode, calls UpdateAirMapIcons (0x46A1E0) and UpdateAirBaseCircles (0x46AD60)** - not the mode's colours, which its setter and the player's fighter orders make; mode 0x13, the naval mode, calls 0x46A6F0; all three on the map object's +0x1DC4. Every path ends with `push esi; call 0x261D20`, the autosave check. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 1. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: As before; the colouring's callers from findRefs.py --callers 0x8673B0.
addresses.revises: Said only the setter made the air mode's colours.

slots_noted: The two destructor bodies are called by the scalar deleting destructors and sit in no table.
